_note: SL-007 review M1, closed as its class: an entry planted where the report's file is written, so that the write goes through it (SC-037). Members come from someone who can create an entry in the report's folder while the scan runs, with the rights of an ordinary account: a hardlink (no privilege), a symbolic link (Developer Mode, which the suite needs already), a junction (no privilege), or an ordinary file or folder. plantAt: where it is planted. 'temporary' is the exact name the next open uses (the test hands ReportFile its stem), 'earlier-stem' is the temporary's name had the stem been drawn at the probe (the name the probe's own file would have shown), 'report' is <report> itself, and 'legacy-tmp' is the fixed <report>.tmp that earlier versions wrote. kind: what is planted. expect: 'refused' (Write throws and touches nothing: CreateNew), 'replaced' (the move replaces the entry as an entry and nothing is written through it), 'ignored' (the name is not written), or 'residual' (what CreateNew does NOT refuse, named so that nobody believes it does: its coveredBy row is the one that holds, and no row expects the OS to refuse it). ReportFileTests reads this file; every row is run, and a residual row must name a coveredBy row of the same kind that is not itself residual.

CreateNew follows a symbolic link to a file that does not exist and creates the file at its target (Go issue 73702, CVE-2025-0913).
